The 0 mark sits just past the 7 cm (70 mm) mark, specifically past the 73 mm mark (each small division on the main scale is 1 mm). Counting from 70 mm: 71, 72, 73 mm. The 0 line is just past 73.0 mm.    - 7 is 70 mm.
   - The marks are spaced every 1 mm.
   - 7.1, 7.2, 7.3. The zero mark of the vernier scale is lined up just after 73 mm (or 7.3 cm). Therefore, the main scale reading is **73.0 mm**.

   - Looking across the vernier scale, the line corresponding to **6** aligns best with one of the main scale markings above it.

   $$\text{Total} = \text{Main Scale Reading} + (\text{Vernier Alignment} \times \text{Least Count})$$
